scope: Independent pre-existing SIEVE research; not a Space Apps event submission
bad_flag_policy: existing conservative SIEVE scanner; SOURCE excluded only from background

detection.association: one-to-one minimum-distance assignment; no reused detections
detection.irsa_source_discovery: SExtractor reference required separately; Photutils comparisons are not IRSA equivalence

injection.psf: nearest released QR3 EPSF zone; Photutils ImagePSF rendered at native subpixel phase and unit-stamp normalized
injection.noise: real-image addition retains original noise; Gaussian blank draws archive variance, no source shot noise added
injection.source_groups: site IDs keep all SNR levels and controls together; no threshold tuning on these sites
limitations: Model-matched injection cannot establish real sensitivity
Gaussian archive noise excludes covariance and source shot noise
Real-image unmatched peaks are not false detections
Blend components and masks remain in denominators

measurement.profile: QR3 D1 finite-ePSF point-source fixed-position flux plus constant background; weighted scipy least squares
measurement.units: uJy using released pixel solid-angle map; scientific CWAVE/CBAND maps
measurement.reference: known injected flux for conditional recovery; official IRSA same-source forced photometry is a separate external check

identity.chosen_factor: held-out pixel spatial-profile predictive evidence for one versus multiple sources
identity.A: Nway-quality positional likelihood with independently qualified astrometric covariance and density/no-counterpart model
identity.B: A plus ordinary photometry with wavelength-dependent prediction and shared covariance
identity.C: B plus competing one/multiple/artifact hypotheses tested on an exposure excluded from A/B and hypothesis generation
identity.evaluation: physical-source-disjoint validation and test; freeze thresholds on validation at matched true-link recall; grouped paired uncertainty
claim_gate: source-disjoint labels and frozen matched-recall thresholds
identity.missing_prerequisite_behavior: INCONCLUSIVE; metrics null with reasons, never zero or NO_IMPROVEMENT

forbidden_claims: real identity improvement from injection alone
